observed: Existing verified failed-attempt backup remained on disk, so check() aborted at its stale assertion before apply() could preserve/archive it. Workflow step 'Prepare bounded native SSH transport' failed; Apply was skipped. Rollback handler reported PINK078_ROLLBACK_ALREADY_APPLIED=PASS. Thus no quota update was attempted by R2 and original protected config remained.
remediation: R3 preflight accepts only strictly proven original config, inactive old/new timers and retained exact backup, first verifies read-only, then archives the old aborted backup under /var/backups/pink-iptv; adds CI regression. Code changes remain limited to quota-only Python/test and gate.
